correctness.rationale: The copula density is a centered rank-one perturbation; its parameter bound follows from exact opposite score maxima. Its transition operator has one nonzero eigenvalue and the n-step density follows by induction. A strict derivative sign argument yields the unique root of the global shape optimization, with boundary and alpha=0 handled. The standalone numerical checker independently replayed arithmetic and kernel convolution; analytic proof, not finite sampling, establishes the universal claim.

value.rationale: The originating family aims to model stronger dependence than classical FGM, while reported rho/gini do not measure its maximal nonlinear dependence or its temporal memory. The exact globally achievable HGR bound and all-lag sharp uniform-density envelope solve a natural familywise optimization and identify the unique most persistent admissible shape. No universal bounds outside this family are claimed.
